effect.bitsandbalance.returning.descript: Teleports you to where you last died, even in another dimension. Does nothing if you haven't died yet or there's no safe spot nearby.
effect.bitsandbalance.displacement.descr: Teleports the affected entity to a random safe spot within 100 blocks.
effect.bitsandbalance.resurfacing.descri: Teleports the affected entity to the highest solid block above it.
effect.bitsandbalance.bioluminescence.de: Makes the affected entity glow, emitting light around it.
